messages.subject: Call for Animal Movement Symposia Speakers for ICCB 2027
parts: I am considering submitting a proposal for an Animal Movement Symposia at the International Congress for Conservation Biology hosted in June/July 2027 in Puebla, Mexico. If you're planning to attend the conference and are interested in participating as a Symposia speaker, please reach out to hayleya...@gmail.com. Symposia speakers would need to cover their own travel and conference fees.
